A [[Roll of Parchment]] is a rare crafting material. It is used in the crafting of [[armor]].

==Acquisition==
*Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s.
*Select [[Prophecies]] and [[Factions]] [[artisan]]s will craft one Roll of Parchment for 5 [[Wood Plank]]s and 20 {{gold}}.
* Possible [[drop]] from [[Hidden Treasure]]s revealed with [[Light of Deldrimor]].
*[[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from:
**Any armor crafted using Rolls of Parchment (see below).
**See [[:Category:Contains parchment]] for other items.
*No [[creature]]s currently appear to drop [[:Category:Drops parchment|Rolls of Parchment]].

==Crafting==
*Armor
**[[Monk scalp designs]]
**[[Monk Dragon armor]]
**[[Monk Star armor]]
**[[Necromancer scar patterns]]
**[[Necromancer Scar Pattern armor]]

*[[Firework]]
**[[Bottle Rocket]] (during [[Canthan New Year]])

== Collectors ==
{{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|22nd June 2009 and 23rd April 2012|Zen Daijun (explorable area)|5 [[Roll of Parchment|Rolls of Parchment]]}}

== Notes ==
* Five Rolls of Parchment are required to complete [[Symon's History of Ascalon]].

== Trivia ==
* [[w:Parchment|Parchment]] is made from limed animal skin, not wood.
